title: A Physics-Informed Hybrid Inverse Machine Learning Framework for High-Dimensional Sparse Recipe Reconstruction: code and synthetic data
description:
Code for the manuscript A Physics-Informed Hybrid Inverse Machine Learning Framework for High-Dimensional Sparse Recipe Reconstruction: the data pipeline, the Kubelka-Munk physics module and the inverse recipe experiments.

The industrial records used in the paper are under a non-disclosure agreement and are not included. The repository contains a synthetic dataset with the same raw-file layout, so the whole pipeline runs; results on it do not reproduce the numbers in the paper.
